summary: Completed full testing of Payroll module (Module 5). Found and fixed a critical bug: all 3 payroll frontend files used page_size=200 for employee API calls, but the employees API enforces le=100 max, causing 422 errors. After fix, all flows working: single entry create+redirect, detail page (edit/approve/mark-as-paid), delete draft, bulk entry (load/remove rows/submit), filters (month/status/employee), and row click navigation. All 23 backend tests passed.

design_issues.screen: Payroll list, single entry form, bulk entry form
issues: Month input fields (filter + payroll month pickers) use browser-native type='month' picker instead of shadcn Calendar component — same UX inconsistency noted in previous modules

bugs_fixed.issue: CRITICAL: api.get('/employees?page_size=200') exceeded employees API max (le=100), causing 422 errors on the payroll list page. The employee filter dropdown was empty.
CRITICAL: Same page_size=200 bug in both SingleEntryForm and BulkEntryForm causing 422 errors. Employee dropdowns were empty, preventing new payroll creation.
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed page_size=200 to page_size=100 in both usages

rca_of_issue.bug: Employee dropdowns empty in all payroll pages (list, create single, create bulk)
rca_of_issue.root_cause: PayrollList.js, PayrollCreate.js (SingleEntryForm), and PayrollCreate.js (BulkEntryForm) all called /api/employees with page_size=200. The employees router has page_size: int = Query(le=100) Pydantic validator. Value 200 > 100 triggers 422 Unprocessable Entity. Frontend .catch() silently swallowed the errors, leaving employees=[].
rca_of_issue.fix: Changed page_size=200 to page_size=100 in all 3 locations
rca_of_issue.pattern: Same root cause as iteration_6 bug in AssetDetail.js - consistent pattern across the codebase
